label.zh: 十项决议各自的违规窗口
label.en: The breach window of each of ten resolutions

note.zh: 每项决议通过后向违反该决议的成员国发出对应窗口；彼此独立，由各决议的通过时机决定。
note.en: Each passed resolution sends its window to the members in breach; independent, set by when each resolution passes.

notes.zh: 五个选项：拒绝、遵守（有政策/科技/政体的门槛）、无视往后的信件（fed_10400_ignore）、处决使节、吃掉使节。
notes.en: Five options: refuse, comply (gated by policies, technologies and civics), ignore future letters (fed_10400_ignore), execute the envoys, eat the envoys.

scope.zh: 银河法违规通知：十项决议通过后的“遵守/保留/拒绝”窗口，以及汇合的“措辞强硬的信”。
scope.en: Galactic law breach notices: the comply / retain / refuse windows after ten resolutions pass, converging on "A Strongly Worded Letter".
